title: LIVE UPDATES: Sara Duterte press conference (October 6, 2026)
summary: Vice President Sara Duterte held a press conference on Tuesday morning in Davao City. Here are the latest news and updates.

blocks.text: Sara Duterte denies Gracioso claims, to submit affidavit on Thursday
Vice President Sara Duterte on Tuesday denied claims made by former Police Patrolman Rodulfo Gracioso Jr. that he delivered suitcases containing cash.
“Mariin kong tinatagi ang mag pahayag ni… Gracioso Jr. sa kanyang sinumpaang salaysay at mga panayaman sa media na inuugnay ako sa mga pangyayaring hindi ko ginawa,” she said in a press briefing.
Duterte said her camp will submit her affidavit on Thursday

To recall, Gracioso previously alleged that he delivered cash to the vice president, Davao City 1st District Representative Paolo Duterte, and forrmer President Rodrigo Duterte on former House Speaker Lord Allan Velasco’s instructions.
Velasco’s camp previously said the allegations against him had “no basis.” —Joahna Lei Casilao/AOL, GMA News
